pruneRule: An id is prune-listed when its flip rate is 20% of exemplars or higher (6 of 30); a flip is majority-level minority presence across the 3 majority-of-3 passes.
operationalization: The design doc sentence "flip in more than 1 of 3 passes on any exemplar" cannot bind per-exemplar with 3 passes (minority presence is the only observable flip), so the threshold is operationalized ACROSS exemplars: at most one flip event per (id, exemplar), prune when the events span more than one distinct exemplar.
note: Report only: config.mjs is never edited by this script; the human applies the prune.
procedure: each pass is a majority-of-3 tag result (the shipped tagging procedure); flips and the prune rule apply at the majority level
derivationNote: pruneList recomputed 2026-07-12 from the recorded flips table under the REGISTERED rule (Life-OS addendum, 2026-07-11 revision); the script originally shipped the superseded more-than-one-exemplar rule and its 26-id list was never applied. Raw flips and voteDetail untouched.
